full_text_en:
Lu Peiji v. Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd. — Dispute over Return of Insurance Compensation

Plaintiff: Lu Peiji, male, 42 years old, residing at No. 32 Nansharp, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Jiangsu Province Wuxi City Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Shi Tianrong, Acting Chairman of Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd.

Agent ad litem: Xu Yanqing, lawyer of Wuxi Foreign Economic Law Firm.

The plaintiff, Lu Peiji, filed a lawsuit with the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province against Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd. for a dispute over the return of insurance compensation. The court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and, after a public trial, found the following:

Facts Found by the Court

The plaintiff, Lu Peiji, was originally a cadre of the defendant, Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd. The defendant entered into a group personal accident insurance contract with the Chinese People's Insurance Company, Wuxi Branch. The contract stipulated that the insurance period was from December 5, 1986 to December 4, 1987; Lu Peiji was one of the insured, with a sum insured of RMB 8,000. The personal accident insurance policy stated that in the event of an insurance compensation claim, the insurance compensation would be transferred by the policyholder to the insured or beneficiary. On September 4, 1987, the plaintiff, Lu Peiji, fell and injured himself at another person's home for personal reasons. He was diagnosed with an avulsion fracture of the right olecranon, for which he took 88 days of sick leave. During this period, the defendant paid Lu Peiji his wages and labor insurance benefits (but not bonuses). On December 19, 1987, the Chinese People's Insurance Company, Wuxi Branch, paid the defendant RMB 704 in insurance compensation in accordance with the agreement. This amount was calculated based on the number of days Lu Peiji was off work. The defendant did not transfer this amount to Lu Peiji. Consequently, Lu Peiji filed a lawsuit with the court, demanding that the defendant return the misappropriated personal accident insurance compensation and compensate for losses calculated at the one-year bank deposit interest rate.

Defendant's Defense

The defendant argued: The company purchased the insurance to prevent accidents to its employees during work and to reduce the economic losses arising therefrom. During the period when the plaintiff, Lu Peiji, was injured for personal reasons and off work, he enjoyed wages, welfare, medical treatment, and other benefits. The company paid the insurance premiums without receiving any compensation; instead, it incurred additional expenses, leading to a new inequitable distribution. Therefore, the company was entitled to the rights to the insurance compensation.

Opinion of the Court

The Wuxi Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant, Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd., purchased group personal accident insurance for its employees, which was a welfare measure for the protection of employees' persons. Article 4 of the Group Personal Accident Insurance Clauses provides: "If the insured sustains death or disability due to an accidental injury during the validity period of the insurance policy, the full or partial insurance amount shall be paid." Although Lu Peiji, after being accidentally injured, enjoyed the wages and medical labor insurance benefits provided by law during the sick leave period, this could not deprive him of the rights and interests he was entitled to under the personal insurance contract. The defendant's refusal to pay Lu Peiji the insurance compensation he was entitled to infringed upon the plaintiff's lawful rights and interests. In accordance with the provisions of Article 117(1) of the General Principles of the Civil Law, the defendant shall bear the liability for returning the insurance compensation paid by the insurance company to the plaintiff. Accordingly, the court rendered the following judgment on August 30, 1989:

Judgment

The defendant, Huade Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd., shall return to the plaintiff, Lu Peiji, the insurance compensation of RMB 704 and interest of RMB 107.17. This amount shall be paid immediately upon the judgment taking effect.

The litigation costs of RMB 30 in this case shall be borne by the defendant.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, neither the plaintiff nor the defendant appealed.
